skills.name: mandatory_image_tool_invocation_for_radiology_tasks
skills.description: When a differential diagnosis task involves interpreting chest imaging or requires visual evidence from radiological studies, the agent must invoke image analysis tools before forming any diagnostic conclusion.

skills.name: Integrate Clinical Context with Imaging Findings in Differential Diagnosis
skills.description: When imaging classifiers suggest multiple competing diagnoses (e.g., edema vs. consolidation), prioritize clinical risk factors and history over visual heuristics to determine the primary etiology.

skills.name: verify_temporal_resolution_for_transient_pathology
skills.description: When initial imaging shows diffuse bilateral opacities, verify if findings resolve rapidly in follow-up images to distinguish transient conditions from persistent pathologies.

skills.name: verify_negative_classifier_with_visual_morphology
skills.description: When a chest X-ray classifier returns no strong findings despite visible pathology, perform direct visual inspection of morphological features and temporal stability to identify chronic or congenital conditions.

skills.name: verify_bilateral_hilar_findings_with_lateral_view
skills.description: When a chest X-ray classifier identifies high-confidence masses in bilateral hilar regions, verify the finding using lateral views to distinguish symmetric adenopathy from malignancy.

skills.name: temporal_severity_quantification
skills.description: When evaluating the evolution of chest pathology over time, explicitly quantify severity changes using a classifier on serial images rather than relying on visual estimation.

skills.name: resolve_imaging_conflict_via_quantitative_evidence
skills.description: When a text-based report generator provides a generic 'normal' assessment that contradicts high-confidence quantitative findings from an image classifier, prioritize the objective classifier data and re-evaluate for subtle pathologies.

skills.name: Contextualize Negative Imaging in High-Risk Trauma
skills.description: When interpreting chest imaging for high-energy blunt trauma, do not rule out vascular injury solely based on the absence of strong parenchymal findings in automated classifiers.

skills.name: fallback_visual_analysis_for_low_confidence_classifier
skills.description: When automated image classifiers return low-confidence or negative findings for suspected acute pathologies, initiate direct visual inspection or report generation to identify subtle radiographic signs.

skills.name: cross_verify_findings_with_multi_view_reports
skills.description: When a specific anatomical finding or lesion visibility is ambiguous in a single view, generate reports for multiple orthogonal views to cross-verify presence or absence.

skills.name: validate_mediastinal_shift_direction
skills.description: When interpreting chest imaging with significant unilateral opacity, explicitly verify the direction of mediastinal shift to distinguish between space-occupying lesions (e.g., effusion) and volume-loss conditions (e.g., atelectasis).

skills.name: multi_image_independent_synthesis
skills.description: When interpreting multiple chest images representing different patients or distinct time points, avoid spatial cross-verification and instead generate independent reports before synthesizing findings.

skills.name: prioritize_report_generator_for_laterality_assessment
skills.description: When diagnosing conditions involving anatomical laterality or spatial orientation (e.g., situs inversus, dextrocardia), prioritize the report generator over the classifier to capture structural landmark positions.

ID_namespace: source_fold + skill_id; IDs may repeat across folds
